text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (August 31, 2023) for 146 Jameson Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (August 31, 2023) for 146 Jameson Avenue, Folder Number: 23 195500 PRS 00 IV and in doing so granted an extension of time to May 13, 2024.
